node.title: L1 boundary shifted-lattice affine Q cell
node.statement: In the balanced shifted-lattice band, the boundary profile d1=w+1,d2=omega has coordinates (W,N)=A g1+B g2 with deg(A)<=omega-w-1 and scalar B. Projectively, B=0 is one fixed-codeword ray from which the exact guard retains at most one member; B!=0 is the unique guarded affine cell g2+A g1. When W1=1 this is exactly a locator-Q fiber with the top w+1 coefficients prescribed. For nonconstant W1 it remains a quotient/residue affine Q cell. Thus the boundary belongs to Q and the interior BC census starts at d1>=w+2; no Q or BC bound is proved.
